CSMatch: Caliper Synthetic Matching — CSMatch-package
text: CSMatch implements Caliper Synthetic Matching (CSM), method matching observational studies. Given observational dataset, CSM matches treated unit set nearby control units using (possibly adaptive) radius/caliper user-specified distance metric covariates, builds synthetic counterfactual treated unit matched controls. package also provides tools choosing distance metric caliper, diagnosing match quality, estimating (getting standard errors ) resulting average treatment effect treated.

title: CSMatch: Caliper Synthetic Matching — CSMatch-package
text: typical workflow : Call get_cal_matches() match treated units nearby control units (see rad_method radius/caliper chosen) generate matched-set weights (see est_method, e.g. synthetic-control weights vs. simple averaging). returns csm_matches object. Use diagnostic tools (e.g. caliper_distance_plot, love_plot, sensitivity_table, caliper_sensitivity_plot) check match quality tune distance metric, scaling, caliper. Refit update_matches() choices change, without respecify entire call. Extract final matched data result_table() .data.frame(), estimate treatment impact estimate_ATT(). See vignette("lalonde-example", package = "CSMatch") worked example, including select distance metric caliper, canonical LaLonde job-training dataset.

text: Initial CRAN submission. Implements Caliper Synthetic Matching (CSM): radius/caliper matching user-specified covariate distance metric, optional synthetic-control weighting step (get_cal_matches()). Diagnostic tools choosing distance metric caliper assessing match quality covariate balance (caliper_distance_plot(), love_plot(), sensitivity_table(), caliper_sensitivity_plot(), related functions).
